question: Alveolar ventilation is the volume of air that:

options.opa: It enters (or exits) the lungs in each breath.
options.opb: It enters (or exits) in the airways every minute.
options.opc: It remains in the alveoli after a normal expiration.
options.opd: Enter (or exit) in the lung exchange zones in one minute
options.ope: It remains in the alveoli after a forced expiration.
